title: Apollo 12 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Oceanus Procellarum, the Moon
place.basis: Latitude and longitude as published by NSSDCA, referenced to the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis lunar reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists Apollo 12: launched 14 November 1969, landed 19 November 1969 at Oceanus Procellarum (3.013 S, 23.422 W).

tiers.everyday: Apollo 12 landed on the Moon on 19 November 1969 in Oceanus Procellarum. NASA lists the site at 3.013 S, 23.422 W on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists a launch on 14 November 1969, 7.75 hours of moonwalk time, a 1.35 km traverse and 34.35 kg of samples. Coordinates use the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame.

unknowns: IAU Gazetteer name for this landing point: not looked up [UNKNOWN] (only the Apollo 11 name was checked)
